Method of Attack: Malicious npm packages impersonate legitimate Hardhat plugins to steal private keys, mnemonics, and configuration files; exploit Hardhat runtime environment functions hreInit() and hreConfig() to collect sensitive data; encrypt data with AES and exfiltrate to attacker-controlled endpoints using hardcoded keys and Ethereum addresses
Attack Vector: Supply chain attack via malicious npm packages impersonating legitimate Hardhat plugins
Indicators of Compromise: hardcoded keys and Ethereum addresses used for data exfiltration
